---
title: "Every region, side by side"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
rates <- read_csv("unemployment.csv") |>
  filter(region != "Kingdom")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.5
ggplot(rates, aes(date, rate, colour = region)) +
  geom_line()
```
